business_problem: Milton Keynes University Hospital needed to reduce clinician burnout and administrative overload caused by slow, manual documentation and EHR work that pulled clinicians away from direct patient care.
solution_summary: Milton Keynes University Hospital piloted Oracle Health AI Agents on top of its Oracle Health Foundation EHR to automate note creation from patient-clinician conversations. The voice-enabled AI agent captures the consultation, drafts clinical notes inside the EHR, and contributes to a single unified patient record so clinicians can spend more time face to face with patients and less time finishing notes later. The rollout targeted outpatient departments and the Same Day Emergency Care unit first, and it was delivered in eight weeks, with early configuration work focused on enabling the features for UK use. Because the pilot is built directly into the existing EHR foundation, the hospital can expand it toward orders, desktop workflows, and other user groups without redesigning the whole clinical system. The result is a practical documentation-automation layer aimed at reducing cognitive load while improving care coordination through a single source of truth.
